name: Pass 21 waiver and reciprocal trace hardening
goal: Close remaining escape hatches in waiver completeness, threshold lowering, and answer-to-decomposition reciprocity.
risks: A weak waiver could hide missing governed evidence
A record could lower its own pass threshold and still claim acceptance
A decomposition node could cite an answer without that answer linking back to the same node

nodes.label: Pass 21 expert critic review

node_contract.what: Review pass 20 and pass 21 controls against original transcript requirements.
node_contract.why: Find remaining ways DFMS could claim rigor without enforceable proof.
node_contract.how: Use governance, decomposition, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.where: Installed skills, workspace bundle, validation fixtures, and design records.
node_contract.who: Codex with governance, requirements, and verification perspectives.
node_contract.how_good: Findings are concrete, fixable, and tied to validation evidence.

nodes.feedback_loop: Each finding must either be fixed in validators or recorded as residual risk.

nodes.label: Waiver, threshold, and reciprocal-link validator hardening

node_contract.what: Patch validators to reject weak waivers, self-lowered thresholds, and one-way answer links.
node_contract.why: Governed factory records must not be able to weaken their own proof obligations.
node_contract.how: Edit installed scripts, sync workspace scripts, and update fixtures.
node_contract.how_good: New negative cases fail and existing positive cases continue passing.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the hardening suite after every validator change.

nodes.label: Negative fixture and hardening runner validation

node_contract.what: Verify the final pass 21 state with positive and negative evidence.
node_contract.why: The pass is only credible if the hardening suite proves both acceptance and rejection paths.
node_contract.how: Run the DFMS hardening runner, merged-record validator, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and ID checks.
node_contract.where: codex-skills validation fixtures and dark-factory-meta-skills-design records.
node_contract.when: After fixes and before final response.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed verification reopens the fix node.
